messages:
claire: quick heads-up — we need a short compatibility pulse with partners before next marketplace batch deploy. want to confirm SDK surface changes and deprecation windows. :wave:
ton y: +1. which breaking flags are live in staging? we should not surprise hw partners or SIs. :eyes:
sana: there's one opt-in flag for response-envelope that landed last week. has no default yet but the docs PR is merged: https://go/internal/partners/sdk-envelopes
mika: Fyi the marketplace package validator will start rejecting packages that call `X-Auth` header after 2026-05-15 unless they pass the compatibility shim test. we should broadcast that date to partners now.
partner-eng-john: thanks — our SI integrators still have a handful of customers on older clients. can we request a 90-day graceful window? also can we provide a small shim lib (python + node) to ease migration?
claire: proposal: announce deprecation today with a 90-day timeline, publish shim libs, and open an opt-out sandbox for partners to verify. create a standard checklist for partner handoffs.
tony: ok. ops question: does Dedicated + Private need different guidance (certs/auth)? should call that out in the checklist.
sana: yes — Private deployments may have custom KMS and network proxies. checklist item: "verify auth header mapping in private envs". I'll add a short snippet to docs.
mika: I'll update marketplace validator docs with the exact reject rules and a sample error payload: ```json
{"error":"deprecated_header","info":"use Authorization: Bearer <token> instead"}
```
partner-eng-john: can we get an SDK patch release with the shim by EOW? our SI schedules are tight.
claire: target: patch for node/python by Fri EOD. engineering to cut canary publish to npm/pypi and notify partners channel. @tony can you coordinate release window?
tony: yes. I'll reserve a canary slot on Tue 03:00 UTC and run the compatibility-runbook. devops-bot, please open a canary job.
devops-bot: @tony — canary job created: job/partner-sdk-compat-canary-177888. CI status will post in #eng-releases. :robot_face:
partner-eng-john: perfect. I'll send partners a short migration template + example upgrade script (curl + node) once canary passes.
claire: communications plan: 1) partner notice doc + migration guide, 2) shim libs + quickstart repos, 3) marketplace pre-checker link, 4) partner office hours next Fri. who owns each?
sana: I'll own the partner notice doc and quickstart snippets.
mika: I'll own shim libs and the marketplace pre-checker updates.
tony: I'll own release scheduling and canary verification.
partner-eng-john: I'll coordinate outreach, set up office hours, and collect integration blockers.
claire: thanks team. small ask — keep replies brief in this thread with blockers only. will post the announcement draft here for review. :thumbsup:
